BX.TRF.PWKR.DT.GD.ZS.definition: Remittance inflows / GDP; not remittance transaction costs (10.c.1).

EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS.definition: Share of renewables in total final energy consumption; not electricity generation and not SDG 13.

FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG.definition: Annual CPI change; negative inflation is possible.

NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG.definition: Aggregate real GDP growth; official 8.1.1 uses real GDP per capita growth.

NY.GDP.PCAP.KD.definition: Real GDP per capita level in constant 2015 US dollars; not PPP dollars, not growth.

SE.SEC.ENRR.definition: Gross secondary enrollment numerator includes pupils of any age; can exceed 100%; not completion or learning achievement.

SI.DST.FRST.20.definition: Bottom 20% income share level; official 10.1.1 measures bottom 40% per-capita welfare growth.

SI.POV.DDAY.classification: Exact official SDG indicator concept; aggregate only
SI.POV.DDAY.definition: Current WDI $3.00/day 2021 PPP; original $2.15 label cannot authenticate archived numeric vintage. Full SDG disaggregation absent.

SI.POV.GINI.definition: Gini distribution index 0–100; survey welfare concepts differ; not a growth statistic.

SI.POV.LMIC.definition: Current WDI $4.20/day 2021 PPP; original $3.65 label cannot authenticate archived numeric vintage. This higher threshold is not SDG extreme poverty 1.1.1.

SI.POV.NAHC.classification: Exact official SDG indicator concept; aggregate only
SI.POV.NAHC.definition: National poverty-line population share; national definitions differ and do not supply full sex/age disaggregation.

SL.TLF.CACT.ZS.definition: Modeled ILO estimate; labour force / population ages15+; not unemployment denominator.

SL.UEM.1524.ZS.definition: Modeled ILO youth unemployment / youth labour force ages15–24, not all youth population, not adult unemployment, not NEET.

SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS.classification: Exact official SDG indicator concept; modeled aggregate
SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS.definition: Modeled ILO unemployment / labour force; full SDG sex/age/disability disaggregations are absent. Total is not adult.

SM.POP.NETM.definition: Immigrants minus emigrants in persons, allowing negative estimates; not remittance-recipient count.

SP.POP.TOTL.definition: Midyear population estimate in persons; national not regional denominator.

SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS.definition: Urban population / total population according to national urban definitions.
